# final_history — lower-only scoped revalidation

Lower verdict: `approve`. Core-fit verdict: approve. I could not reproduce a correctness defect in the delta from `e126316ce6fa724b19353501a817ab89a6f08af3` to `5a9f044f84fbcc21597f7bf44466cab9b3694b42`.

The new revision is a direct child of the previously reviewed lower revision. All three ancestry assertions pass: the prior lower revision, current main `326d8ed5fa4f89eaa1402a54d8377dba5946be12`, and original PR88 `af6a7438ed7e362de35fee825c70a767573e4fb6` remain ancestors. The exact four-path diff changes the Unicode predicate, adds two regression methods, and appends to two existing recovery-task records. Both record files retain their previous bytes as exact prefixes. No handover, ADR, live queue item, task claim/status, contract, hook, receipt grammar, or test-discovery configuration changes in this delta.

The pinned 21 ranges contain exactly the same 170 of 170 format-control code points as Python 3.14.6's Unicode 16.0.0 database. Exhaustive comparison of the full predicate against that database plus the existing non-format ranges matched for all 1,114,112 of 1,114,112 Unicode code points, with zero mismatches. The update therefore preserves the previous supported Python 3.14 classification while enforcing it on Python 3.9. The current prose-normalization helper is unchanged.

The selected methods include both new tests, real-history frozen-source admission, legal queue lifecycle, retry claims/resolution and legacy migration, literal versus encoded controls, escaped entity/code forms, preserved hidden source, and task-start/inferred-scope tests. This is a selected suite, not the full repository suite. The test script prints every selected method and the real summary. The negative control replaces only the imported Boolean predicate in memory with its previous implementation; it retains all new tests and current lifecycle checks. Its harness exits 0 only if the tests fail without execution errors.

Environment: Darwin 25.5.0 arm64, Git 2.55.0; `python3` is Python 3.14.6 with Unicode 16.0.0; `/usr/bin/python3` is Python 3.9.6 with Unicode 13.0.0. Working directory was `/private/tmp/agentfold-final-review-lower-r2`, an independent clone with `.git` as its common directory. The clone remained clean. No files, index, or refs in that clone were changed; all scripts and temporary Git fixtures were under `/private/tmp/final-history-*`.

Core fit: agent substitution, provider substitution, and repository substitution pass. The delta keeps the existing repository-local byte-preservation rule consistent across supported Python runtimes using a static Unicode table; it introduces no dependency, provider-specific mechanism, or user-global configuration. The deterministic gate passed; `--require-review` was not invoked, so this judgment is not represented as a validated formal receipt.

Findings: none. Limits: no upper repair, combined candidate, final closing records, hosted CI, PR readiness, or full-suite result is certified here. I did not take another owner-worktree snapshot during this scoped pass. The original preservation audit remains bounded to its recorded snapshots; the unchanged immutable paths and retained ancestry carry its lower-tree evidence forward.
